sections.heading: Sell your work, your way.
body: Publish your content, open a store for digital downloads and memberships, and grow an audience — all on one platform you fully control.

sections.heading: Your work deserves better than a rented storefront bolted to a separate site. Aglyn puts your portfolio, your content, and your store in one place you actually own.
Everything to publish and get paid.

items.title: Site, store, and content in one
items.body: Your portfolio, blog, and shop live together — no separate storefront to bolt on.

items.title: Members & sign-ups
items.body: Let fans create accounts, then gate content or perks behind a membership (Business and up).

items.title: Own your audience
items.body: Your members and their data live in your own console, and Aglyn is open source — no walled garden.

items.title: A real media library
items.body: Upload images and video into a DAM with folders and metadata, delivered fast on a CDN.

items.title: Sell digital goods & subscriptions
items.body: Take payments through Stripe for downloads, memberships, and recurring plans.

items.title: Design-first, no code
items.body: Build a site that looks like you on a live canvas — no templates to fight.

sections.heading: Your work, organized and fast.
body: Upload images and video into a real DAM with folders, drag-and-drop, and custom metadata — all delivered responsive on a global CDN so your portfolio loads fast everywhere.

items.title: Folders & metadata
items.body: Organize assets into folders and tag them with your own fields.

items.title: Video & files
items.body: Upload video and downloadable files, not just images (Pro and up).

items.title: Fast everywhere
items.body: Responsive image variants are served from a global CDN automatically.

sections.heading: From first post to first sale.

items.title: Build your space
items.body: Design your site and portfolio on a live canvas, in your own style.

items.title: Add a store
items.body: List digital downloads, memberships, or products and connect Stripe.

items.title: Publish & grow
items.body: Ship to your domain, sign up members, and reach them with built-in email.

items.title: Media
items.body: A real DAM — folders, drag-and-drop, metadata.

items.title: Besigner
items.body: Design on a live canvas and publish in one click.

sections.heading: Start creating on Aglyn.
body: Free to start — publish your work and open your store in minutes.
